title: Highly Selective Novel Heme Oxygenase-1-Targeting Molecules Discovered by DNA-Encoded Library-Machine Learning Model beyond the DEL Chemical Space
authors: Shuai Han; Xinyun Guo; Min Wang; Huan Liu; Yidan Song; Yunyun He; Kuang-Lung Hsueh; Weiren Cui; Wenji Su; Letian Kuai; Jason Deng
one_liner_zh: 该文利用DNA编码库与机器学习发现HO-1抑制剂，对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: DNA-encoded library (DEL) technology has proven to be a powerful method for discovering novel inhibitors for diverse targets. Particularly when combined with machine learning (ML), the DEL-ML workflow expands the chemical space and enhances cost-effectiveness, offering new opportunities to find desired hit molecules. Heme oxygenase-1 (HO-1), primarily a heme-degrading enzyme, has been identified as a potential therapeutic target in diseases such as cancer and neurodegenerative disorders. Despite years of study, the HO-1 inhibitor toolbox remains limited. Here, we report the discovery of five series of novel scaffold HO-1 inhibitors using a DEL-ML workflow that emphasizes the model’s uncertainty quantification and its domain of applicability. The DEL-ML model demonstrated a strong ability to extrapolate to novel chemical spaces by identifying new structures. Approximately 33% of the predicted molecules, validated by biophysical assays, had a binding affinity of K¬D <15 µM, with the strongest affinity being 141 nM. Fourteen tested molecules showed over 100-fold selectivity towards HO-1 over Heme oxygenase-2 (HO-2). These molecules are also structurally novel compared to the reported HO-1 inhibitors. Further, binding mode simulations via docking provided insights into the possible selectivity rationale of some selective series.
abstract_zh: DNA编码文库（DEL）技术已被证明是发现针对多种靶点的新型抑制剂的有效方法。特别是当与机器学习（ML）结合时，DEL-ML工作流程扩展了化学空间并增强了成本效益，为寻找所需命中分子提供了新机会。血红素加氧酶-1（HO-1）主要是一种血红素降解酶，已被确定为癌症和神经退行性疾病等疾病中的潜在治疗靶点。尽管经过多年研究，HO-1抑制剂工具箱仍然有限。在此，我们报告了使用强调模型不确定性量化及其适用领域的DEL-ML工作流程，发现了五个系列的新型骨架HO-1抑制剂。DEL-ML模型通过识别新结构，展示了向新化学空间外推的强大能力。经生物物理测定验证，约33%的预测分子具有K¬D <15 µM的结合亲和力，最强亲和力为141 nM。十四个测试分子对HO-1相对于血红素加氧酶-2（HO-2）显示出超过100倍的选择性。这些分子与已报道的HO-1抑制剂相比，在结构上也是新颖的。此外，通过对接进行的结合模式模拟为某些选择性系列的可能选择性原理提供了见解。
